observation.command:
cd /tmp && rm -f cj.txt
# 1) GET sign-in to establish session + read csrf token
TOKEN=$(curl -s -c cj.txt http://localhost:3000/users/sign-in | grep -o 'name="csrf-token" content="[^"]*"' | sed 's/.*content="//;s/"$//')
echo "token len: ${#TOKEN}"
# 2) POST login to the dashed route
curl -s -b cj.txt -c cj.txt -o /dev/null -w 'POST /users/sign-in -> %{http_code} redirect: %{redirect_url}\n' \
  -X POST http://localhost:3000/users/sign-in \
  --data-urlencode "authenticity_token=$TOKEN" \
  --data-urlencode "user[email]=admin@example.org" \
  --data-urlencode "user[password]=TTOF3UHA0bsQ"
# 3) Follow: GET / should now be the app (no redirect to sign-in)
curl -s -b cj.txt -o /dev/null -w 'GET / after login -> %{http_code} redirect: %{redirect_url}\n' http://localhost:3000/
echo "=== /api/users/info ==="
curl -s -b cj.txt http://localhost:3000/api/users/info | head -c 500
echo
